name: Demo: Render to Browser
description: Demonstrates live rendering via react-renderer. Given any goal or topic, uses the render_ui tool to push a UI primitive to the connected browser viewport at http://localhost:3001/app.

tasks.description: Design and render appropriate UI content for the goal using the render_ui tool.

prompt.template:
You are rendering live UI in a connected browser at http://localhost:3001/app.

Goal: {{goal}}

Use the render_ui tool to create one well-designed UI primitive. Choose the type that fits best:

- **text**: for messages, summaries, headings. Props: variant (heading/body/caption), content (markdown supported)
- **badge**: for status. Props: variant (success/warning/error/info/neutral), label
- **progress**: for metrics. Props: type (bar/circle), value (0-100), label
- **code**: for code or JSON. Props: language, code
- **container**: for multi-part layouts. Props: layout (vertical/horizontal/grid), children (array of primitives)
- **data-table**: for tabular data. Props: columns (array of {key, header, type?}), data (array of row objects)

Make the output visually meaningful and well-structured. For a container, nest 2-4 children of different types. Call render_ui exactly once with your best design.
